name: descriptive-helper-examples
goal: Public helper examples explain distinct behaviors with descriptive titles and no redundant demonstrations

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Generic numbered titles and redundant examples were accepted after required-example delivery; user screenshot shows formatDuration repetitions.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing unit-documentation execution, units CLI and tenant template tests asserted presence and results but no descriptive title or duplicate behavior control.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Recorded failure at 4d66bfe3: Descriptive behavior titles, missing tenant behavior guidance and acceptance of indexed placeholder examples.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Review representative behaviors and enforce descriptive non-numbered titles, unique normalized titles and unique calls; teach semantic review in generated guidance.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: 5832974a changes all ten public helper contracts, current registry guard and generated tenant guidance without changing helper implementations.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 5832974a passes the identical snapshot command, frozen corpus and environment paired with failing 4d66bfe3; all eleven tests pass.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated snapshot restored the old validator: indexed placeholder examples made the unchanged CLI test fail. Restoring the repair passed. Logs are retained in /tmp/harness-helper-behavior-guard-{red,green}.log.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
